question: Loop v2 (stop-lag motion model, loaded camera correction, loaded look hysteresis): does the student carry the box through the door on its own estimate on NEW seeds?
previous_cohort: experiments/2026-09-25-zone-owncam-loop (test box 1/3, nobox 3/3); its test seeds 41-43 are not reused
student_inputs: own issued commands, own wrist RGB (JPEG q90 of robot_cam 640x480), static tagged map v2, calibration_loop_v2.json (dev fits only), fixed pickup-grid cells as static keep-outs; never live poses
teacher_part: box condition only: the GT teacher drives to the cyan box, grasps and lifts it (weld OFF); the student takes over at the teacher carry phase and does everything after (posture change, looks, planning, driving). Teacher part is reported separately and never counted as student success
goal: door-exit waypoint W = (door_x + 0.45, door_y) = (2.65, 0.05); the student ends by declaring arrival

gates.R1_exit_waypoint: at the declared arrival, GT base distance to W <= 0.10 m (no declaration = fail)
gates.R2_no_wall_contact: no contact between any geom of the robot (or the held box) and a wall geom during the student part
gates.R3_estimate_near_door: p90 of |estimate - GT| position over observed frames with GT in the door region (|x-2.2|<=0.6, |y-0.05|<=0.5) < 0.06 m (yaw p90 reported)
gates.R4_box_held: box condition: GT box z > 0.045 m at every sample of the student part and at arrival
gates.episode_pass: R1 and R2 and R3 (and R4 for box)

cohort_gate.C2: 0 wall contacts and 0 box drops (R4) over all 6 test episodes
cohort_gate.pass: C1 and C2; this decides whether M1 integration proceeds

reporting: dev and test separately, k/n per split; per-episode R1-R4 values, SIM time (student and teacher separately), looks and reasons, commands, tag visibility, contacts, load average

episode: SIM 240 s after the student starts
estimator not initialized after 3 consecutive stop-and-look sweeps (not_initialized)
estimate std_xy > 0.15 m after 3 consecutive sweeps without a fix (lost)
box condition: teacher grasp not reached within 400 s SIM (teacher failure, not a student episode)
stop_rule.cohort: dev (seeds 31-33) may be rerun while debugging, all attempts kept; the source and calibration are frozen (frozen_source.json) before test; test (seeds 61-66) runs once, no reruns except an infrastructure crash (kept and labelled)

contact_profile_note: local_contact_fine as in cohort 1 (PR #181 reports a 2.1 mm/min grip creep artifact under this profile; R4 still gates box height)
label_note: offline re-analysis of cohort-1 runs is post hoc and not part of this cohort
